H3005.name: Ibsam
H3005.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3005.short: Ibsam was a descendant of Issachar, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Issachar in 1 Chronicles.

H3031.name: Idbash
H3031.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3031.short: Idbash was a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

H3035G.name: Iddo
H3035G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3035G.brief: Zechariah's son, a leader of Manasseh
H3035G.short: Iddo, the son of Zechariah, was a leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during King David's reign.

H3008I.name: Igal
H3008I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3008I.short: Igal was a descendant of King David, mentioned in the genealogy of David's descendants through his son Jeconiah.

H3008H.name: Igal
H3008H.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H3008H.short: Igal son of Nathan of Zobah was listed among David's mighty warriors known for their military prowess and bravery.

H3008G.name: Igal
H3008G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3008G.brief: A scout from the tribe of Issachar.
H3008G.short: Igal son of Joseph, from the tribe of Issachar, was one of the twelve scouts sent by Moses to explore Canaan.

H3012.name: Igdaliah
H3012.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3012.brief: A man of God during Jeremiah's time.
H3012.short: Igdaliah, a man of God, was associated with a chamber in the house of the Lord during the time of the prophet Jeremiah.

H3003H.name: Jabesh
H3003H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3003H.brief: Assassinated Zechariah; reigned as king of Israel for a month.
H3003H.short: Jabesh, the son of Shallum, conspired against and assassinated Zechariah, becoming king of Israel, but reigned for only one month before being killed by Menahem.

H3047.name: Jada
H3047.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3047.brief: Son of Onam and brother of Shammai.
H3047.short: Jada was the son of Onam and the brother of Shammai, from the tribe of Judah.

H3035H.name: Jaddai
H3035H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3035H.brief: Israelite who agreed to put away his foreign wife.
H3035H.short: Jaddai was among the Israelites who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's reforms.

H3037G.name: Jaddua
H3037G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3037G.brief: One of the leaders who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.
H3037G.short: Jaddua was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant made by the people of Israel during Nehemiah's time.

H3037H.name: Jaddua
H3037H.desc: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
H3037H.brief: High priest during the time of Alexander the Great.
H3037H.short: Jaddua served as the high priest during the reign of Darius the Persian and was contemporary with Alexander the Great.

H3036.name: Jadon
H3036.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3036.brief: Meronothite who helped repair Jerusalem's walls under Nehemiah.
H3036.short: Jadon the Meronothite was one of the people who helped repair the walls of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

H3056.name: Jahdai
H3056.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3056.brief: Descendant of Caleb, son of Jephunneh.
H3056.short: Jahdai was one of the descendants of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.

H3000.name: Jeberechiah
H3000.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3000.brief: Witness to Isaiah's prophecy about Maher-shalal-hash-baz
H3000.short: Jeberechiah was a witness to Isaiah's prophecy concerning his son Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

H3048H.name: Jedaiah
H3048H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3048H.brief: Head of a priestly division during David's reign
H3048H.short: Jedaiah was the head of the second priestly division during King David's reign and his descendants returned from the Babylonian exile.

H3042G.name: Jedaiah
H3042G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3042G.short: Jedaiah was a descendant of Simeon mentioned in a genealogy.

H3048G.name: Jedaiah
H3048G.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H3048G.brief: Priest who settled in Jerusalem after the exile
H3048G.short: Jedaiah was a priest who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile and served in the temple.

H3048I.name: Jedaiah
H3048I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3048I.short: Jedaiah was a priest who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel and signed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H3042H.name: Jedaiah
H3042H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3042H.brief: Repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall
H3042H.short: Jedaiah made repairs to a section of Jerusalem's wall near his house during Nehemiah's rebuilding project.

H3048J.name: Jedaiah
H3048J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3048J.brief: Returned exile who provided silver and gold for crowns
H3048J.short: Jedaiah was a returned exile who provided silver and gold for the crowns placed on Joshua's head.

H3043H.name: Jediael
H3043H.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3043H.brief: One of David's mighty men from the tribe of Manasseh
H3043H.short: Jediael the son of Shimri was one of David's mighty men from the tribe of Manasseh.

H3043I.name: Jediael
H3043I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3043I.brief: Manassite who joined David at Ziklag
H3043I.short: Jediael was one of the Manassites who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from Saul.

H3043J.name: Jediael
H3043J.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3043J.short: Jediael was a Levite gatekeeper, the second son of Meshelemiah, during the time of David.

H3043G.name: Jediael
H3043G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3043G.brief: Son of Benjamin, head of a clan
H3043G.short: Jediael was a son of Benjamin and the head of a Benjamite clan.

H3040.name: Jedidah
H3040.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3040.brief: Mother of King Josiah of Judah
H3040.short: Jedidah was the mother of King Josiah of Judah and the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

H3038G.name: Jeduthun
H3038G.desc: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
H3038G.brief: Levitical musician and singer during David's reign
H3038G.short: Jeduthun, also known as Ethan, was a Levitical musician and singer during the reign of King David.

H3038H.name: Jeduthun
H3038H.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H3038H.brief: Levite gatekeeper and singer in post-exilic Jerusalem
H3038H.short: Jeduthun was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper and singer in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H3094G.name: Jehallelel
H3094G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3094G.brief: Son of Elah, descendant of Judah
H3094G.short: Jehallelel was a son of Elah and a descendant of Judah.

H3094H.name: Jehallelel
H3094H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3094H.brief: Levite who helped purify the temple under Hezekiah
H3094H.short: Jehallelel, a Levite from the Merari clan, helped purify the temple during King Hezekiah's religious reforms.

H3085.name: Jehoaddah
H3085.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3085.short: Jehoaddah, also known as Jarah, was a descendant of King Saul mentioned in the genealogies of Benjamin.

H3086.name: Jehoaddan
H3086.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3086.brief: Mother of King Amaziah of Judah
H3086.short: Jehoaddan was the mother of King Amaziah of Judah and was from Jerusalem.

H3059G.name: Jehoahaz
H3059G.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3059G.brief: King of Israel, son of Jehu
H3059G.short: Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, was king of Israel and reigned for seventeen years.

H3059H.name: Jehoahaz
H3059H.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3059H.brief: King of Judah, son of Josiah
H3059H.short: Jehoahaz, also known as Johanan, was a king of Judah and the son of Josiah.

H3076I.name: Jehohanan
H3076I.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3076I.brief: Levite gatekeeper during the reign of David
H3076I.short: Jehohanan was a Levite gatekeeper during the reign of King David.

H3076J.name: Jehohanan
H3076J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3076J.brief: Military commander under King Jehoshaphat of Judah
H3076J.short: Jehohanan was a military commander from Judah during the reign of King Jehoshaphat.

H3076K.name: Jehohanan
H3076K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3076K.brief: Father of Ishmael, a military leader under Jehoiada
H3076K.short: Jehohanan was the father of Ishmael, one of the military leaders who supported Jehoiada in his coup against Athaliah.

H3076N.name: Jehohanan
H3076N.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3076N.brief: Israelite who married a foreign woman during the Exile
H3076N.short: Jehohanan, one of the descendants of Bebai, married a foreign woman during the Exile but pledged to put her away.

H3076M.name: Jehohanan
H3076M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3076M.brief: Son of Eliashib, a priest during Ezra's time
H3076M.short: Jehohanan was the son of Eliashib, a priest during the time of Ezra.

H3076P.name: Jehohanan
H3076P.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3076P.brief: Head of a priestly family during the high priesthood of Joiakim
H3076P.short: Jehohanan was the head of a priestly family during the time of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua.

H3076Q.name: Jehohanan
H3076Q.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3076Q.brief: Priest during the dedication of Jerusalem's walls
H3076Q.short: Jehohanan was one of the priests who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's walls during Nehemiah's time.

H3076O.name: Jehohanan
H3076O.desc: Ammonite living at the time of Exile and Return
H3076O.brief: Father-in-law of Tobiah, an opponent of Nehemiah
H3076O.short: Jehohanan was the father-in-law of Tobiah, an opponent of Nehemiah during the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls.

H3078.name: Jehoiachin
H3078.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3078.brief: King of Judah, son of Jehoiakim
H3078.short: Jehoiachin, also known as Jeconiah, Coniah, or Shallum, was a king of Judah who reigned for three months before being exiled to Babylon.

H3077I.name: Jehoiada
H3077I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3077I.brief: Counselor to King David after Ahithophel
H3077I.short: Jehoiada, the son of Benaiah, succeeded Ahithophel as King David's counselor.

H3077H.name: Jehoiada
H3077H.desc: High Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3077H.brief: High priest who overthrew Athaliah and crowned Joash
H3077H.short: Jehoiada, also known as Barachiah, was a high priest who led a revolt against Queen Athaliah and crowned Joash as king of Judah.

H3077G.name: Jehoiada
H3077G.desc: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
H3077G.brief: Father of one of David's warriors, Benaiah
H3077G.short: Jehoiada was the father  of one of David's warriors who commanded the Kerethites and Pelethites;

H3077J.name: Jehoiada
H3077J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3077J.brief: Overseer in the house of the Lord
H3077J.short: Jehoiada was appointed as an overseer in the house of the Lord during the time of Jeremiah.

H3079G.name: Jehoiakim
H3079G.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3079G.brief: King of Judah, son of Josiah
H3079G.short: Jehoiakim, also known as Eliakim, was a king of Judah who reigned for eleven years before being succeeded by his son Jehoiachin.

H3080G.name: Jehoiarib
H3080G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3080G.brief: Head of a priestly division during David's reign
H3080G.short: Jehoiarib was the head of the first priestly division organized by King David.

H3083L.name: Jehonathan
H3083L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3083L.brief: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
H3083L.short: Jehonathan was a Levite sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

H3083M.name: Jehonathan
H3083M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3083M.brief: Head of a priestly family during the high priesthood of Joiakim
H3083M.short: Jehonathan was the head of the priestly family of Shemaiah during the time of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua.

H3088G.name: Jehoram
H3088G.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3088G.brief: Son of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah.
H3088G.short: Jehoram, also known as Joram, was the son of Jehoshaphat and king of Judah.

H3088H.name: Jehoram
H3088H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3088H.brief: A Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach.
H3088H.short: Jehoram was a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah.

H3092I.name: Jehoshaphat
H3092I.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3092I.brief: Son of Asa, king of Judah.
H3092I.short: Jehoshaphat was the son of Asa and became a powerful and righteous king of Judah.

H3092H.name: Jehoshaphat
H3092H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H3092H.short: Jehoshaphat, son of Paruah, was one of Solomon's twelve officers responsible for providing food for the king and his household.

H3092J.name: Jehoshaphat
H3092J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3092J.brief: Father of Jehu, king of Israel.
H3092J.short: Jehoshaphat was the father of Jehu, who became king of Israel.

H3092G.name: Jehoshaphat
H3092G.desc: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
H3092G.short: Jehoshaphat served as a recorder for King David and his son Solomon.

H3089.name: Jehosheba
H3089.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3089.brief: Daughter of Jehoram, saved Joash from Athaliah's massacre.
H3089.short: Jehosheba, also known as Jehoshabeath, was the daughter of King Jehoram and the wife of Jehoiada the priest; she saved the infant Joash from Athaliah's massacre of the royal family.

H3075H.name: Jehozabad
H3075H.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H3075H.brief: Son of Obed-edom, a gatekeeper for the ark.
H3075H.short: Jehozabad was one of the sons of Obed-edom who served as a gatekeeper for the ark of the covenant.

H3075I.name: Jehozabad
H3075I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3075I.short: Jehozabad was a commander who led 180,000 warriors under King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

H3075G.name: Jehozabad
H3075G.desc: Moabite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3075G.brief: Son of Shomer, killed King Joash of Judah.
H3075G.short: Jehozabad, the son of Shomer, was one of the servants who conspired against and killed King Joash of Judah.

H3087.name: Jehozadak
H3087.desc: High Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
H3087.brief: Father of Joshua the high priest during the exile.
H3087.short: Jehozadak (or Jozadak) was the father of Joshua, the high priest who returned from the Babylonian exile and helped rebuild the temple.

H3058K.name: Jehu
H3058K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3058K.brief: A Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
H3058K.short: Jehu was one of the Benjamite archers and slingers who joined David at Ziklag while he was hiding from Saul.

H3058I.name: Jehu
H3058I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3058I.brief: Son of Obed, a descendant of Judah.
H3058I.short: Jehu was a descendant of Judah through Obed, as recorded in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

H3058J.name: Jehu
H3058J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3058J.brief: Son of Joshibiah, a descendant of Simeon.
H3058J.short: Jehu, the son of Joshibiah, was a descendant of Simeon mentioned in the genealogy recorded in 1 Chronicles.

H3058G.name: Jehu
H3058G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3058G.brief: Son of Hanani, prophet during the reign of Baasha and Jehoshaphat.
H3058G.short: Jehu, the son of Hanani, was a prophet who prophesied against Baasha, king of Israel, and later rebuked Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, for his alliance with Ahab.

H3058H.name: Jehu
H3058H.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3058H.brief: Son of Jehoshaphat, king of Israel, destroyed Ahab's dynasty.
H3058H.short: Jehu, son of Jehoshaphat, was anointed king of Israel by Elisha's servant; he destroyed the house of Ahab and the worship of Baal, but continued in the sins of Jeroboam.

H3081.name: Jehucal
H3081.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3081.brief: An official during Zedekiah's reign, opposed Jeremiah.
H3081.short: Jehucal (or Jucal) was an official during King Zedekiah's reign who opposed the prophet Jeremiah and sought his punishment.

H3065.name: Jehudi
H3065.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3065.brief: An official who read Jeremiah's scroll to Jehoiakim.
H3065.short: Jehudi was an official during King Jehoiakim's reign who read Jeremiah's scroll to the king, who then burned it piece by piece.

H3057.name: Jehudijah
H3057.brief: Wife of Mered; mother of Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel.
H3057.short: Jehudijah (or the Judahite) was the wife of Mered and the mother of Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel, as recorded in the genealogy of Judah.

H3044.name: Jidlaph
H3044.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3044.short: Jidlaph, a son of Nahor and Milcah, was Abraham's nephew.

H3097H.name: Joab
H3097H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3097H.brief: Son of Seraiah, founder of Ge-harashim
H3097H.short: Joab, the son of Seraiah, was the  father (ie founder) of Ge-harashim.

H3097G.name: Joab
H3097G.desc: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
H3097G.brief: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army
H3097G.short: Joab, David's nephew and commander of his army, was a key figure in David's reign, known for his military prowess and loyalty.

H3097I.name: Joab
H3097I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3097I.brief: Ancestor of a family that returned from Babylonian exile
H3097I.short: Joab was the ancestor of a family that returned to Judah from Babylonian exile.

H3097J.name: Joab
H3097J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3097J.brief: A descendant of Pahath-Moab who returned with Ezra
H3097J.short: Joab, a descendant of Pahath-Moab, was among those who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

H3098I.name: Joah
H3098I.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H3098I.brief: A son of Obed-edom, a gatekeeper of the temple
H3098I.short: Joah, a son of Obed-edom, was one of the gatekeepers assigned to guard the temple.

H3098H.name: Joah
H3098H.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3098H.brief: A Gershonite Levite, son of Zimmah
H3098H.short: Joah (or Ethan), a Gershonite Levite, was the son of Zimmah in the genealogy of Levi.

H3098K.name: Joah
H3098K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3098K.brief: A Levite who helped cleanse the temple under Hezekiah
H3098K.short: Joah, a Levite of the Gershonites, assisted in the purification of the temple during Hezekiah's reign.

H3098L.name: Joah
H3098L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3098L.brief: A Levite who helped purify the temple
H3098L.short: Joah son of Joahaz was a Kohathite Levite who helped purify the temple under King Hezekiah.

H3098J.name: Joah
H3098J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3098J.brief: Son of Joahaz, King Josiah's secretary
H3098J.short: Joah, the son of Joahaz, served as King Josiah's secretary during the temple repairs.

H3098G.name: Joah
H3098G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3098G.brief: Son of Asaph, King Hezekiah's secretary
H3098G.short: Joah, the son of Asaph, served as King Hezekiah's secretary during the Assyrian invasion.

H3099G.name: Joahaz
H3099G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3099G.brief: Father of Joah, King Josiah's secretary
H3099G.short: Joahaz was the father of Joah, who served as King Josiah's secretary during the temple repairs.

H3020.name: Jogli
H3020.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3020.brief: A leader from the tribe of Dan
H3020.short: Jogli, the son of Bukki, was a leader from the tribe of Dan appointed to help divide the Promised Land.

H3076H.name: Johanan
H3076H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3076H.brief: A Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
H3076H.short: Johanan, a Gadite warrior, was one of the men who joined David at Ziklag and helped him fight against raiding bands.

H3076G.name: Johanan
H3076G.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3076G.brief: A Benjaminite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
H3076G.short: Johanan, a Benjaminite warrior, was among the mighty men who joined David at Ziklag.

H3076L.name: Johanan
H3076L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3076L.brief: An Ephraimite leader during the reign of Ahaz
H3076L.short: Johanan, the son of Jehohanan, was one of the leaders of Ephraim who opposed the bringing of Judean captives to Samaria.

H3082G.name: Jonadab
H3082G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3082G.brief: Son of Rechab, who promoted Rechabite lifestyle
H3082G.short: Jonadab, the son of Rechab, instructed his descendants to abstain from wine, live in tents, and follow a nomadic lifestyle, which they faithfully observed.

H3083K.name: Jonathan
H3083K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3083K.short: Jonathan, the son of Uzziah, was one of King David's officials in charge of the royal treasuries.

H3083H.name: Jonathan
H3083H.desc: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
H3083H.brief: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David
H3083H.short: Jonathan, the eldest son of King Saul, was a valiant warrior and a close friend of David, ultimately dying in battle alongside his father.

H3083I.name: Jonathan
H3083I.desc: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
H3083I.brief: Son of Abiathar the priest during David's reign
H3083I.short: Jonathan, the son of Abiathar the priest, served as a messenger and informant for David during Absalom's rebellion.

H3083J.name: Jonathan
H3083J.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H3083J.brief: Son of Shammah the Hararite, one of David's mighty men
H3083J.short: Jonathan, the son of Shammah the Hararite, was one of David's mighty men, known for his military prowess.

H3083G.name: Jonathan
H3083G.brief: A Levite who served as a priest for Dan
H3083G.short: Jonathan, a Levite from Bethlehem, became a priest for the tribe of Dan after they set up a carved image.

H3083N.name: Jonathan
H3083N.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3083N.brief: Scribe with a house used as prison
H3083N.short: Jonathan was a scribe who had a house in Jerusalem that was used as a prison.

H3091H.name: Joshua
H3091H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H3091H.brief: Owner of a field in Beth-shemesh
H3091H.short: The ark of the covenant was placed on a rock in the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh.

H3091I.name: Joshua
H3091I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3091I.brief: Governor of Jerusalem during Josiah's reign
H3091I.short: Joshua was the governor of Jerusalem during the reign of King Josiah.

H3091G.name: Joshua
H3091G.desc: Judge living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness and Conquest
H3091G.brief: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan
H3091G.short: Joshua, the son of Nun, was Moses' assistant and successor who led the Israelites into the Promised Land.

H3091J.name: Joshua
H3091J.desc: High Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
H3091J.brief: High priest during the rebuilding of the temple
H3091J.short: Joshua (or Jeshua), the son of Jehozadak, was the high priest who led the rebuilding of the temple after the Babylonian exile.

H3063H.name: Judah
H3063H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3063H.brief: A Levite who married a foreign woman
H3063H.short: Judah was one of the Levites who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to put them away.

H3063G.name: Judah
H3063G.desc: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3063G.short: Judah, also known as the Jews or Judea, refers to the Israelite tribe, the southern kingdom, and the Roman province in various biblical contexts.

H3063I.name: Judah
H3063I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3063I.brief: Leader of Judahites living in Jerusalem
H3063I.short: Judah was a leader of the people of Judah living in Jerusalem after the exile.

H3063K.name: Judah
H3063K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3063K.brief: A priest who participated in the dedication ceremony
H3063K.short: Judah, along with other priests, played musical instruments during the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem.

H3063J.name: Judah
H3063J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3063J.brief: A Levite who participated in the dedication ceremony
H3063J.short: Judah was one of the Levites who led the thanksgiving choir during the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem.

H3067.name: Judith
H3067.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3067.brief: A Hittite woman who married Esau
H3067.short: Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, was one of Esau's wives, causing grief to Isaac and Rebekah.

H3030.name: Idalah
H3030.short: Idalah, a town in the territory of Zebulun (<ref="Joshua 19:15">Joshua 19:15</ref>).

H3003G.name: Jabesh
H3003G.brief: A town in Gilead, loyal to Saul
H3003G.short: Jabesh-gilead, a town in Gilead known for its loyalty to King Saul.

H3017.name: Jagur
H3017.brief: A town in the Negev of Judah
H3017.short: Jagur, a town in the Negev region of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:21">Joshua 15:21</ref>).

H3096.name: Jahaz
H3096.brief: A town in Moab, site of Israelite victories
H3096.short: Jahaz (Jahzah), a Moabite town where the Israelites defeated Sihon and later allotted to Reuben.

H3055.name: Jehud
H3055.short: Jehud, a town allotted to the tribe of Dan (<ref="Joshua 19:45">Joshua 19:45</ref>).

H3011.name: Jogbehah
H3011.brief: A town in Gilead, fortified by the Gadites
H3011.short: Jogbehah, a town in Gilead fortified by the Gadites (<ref="Numbers 32:35">Numbers 32:35</ref>), was located near the route Gideon took when pursuing the Midianites (<ref="Judges 8:11">Judges 8:11</ref>).

H3063N.name: Judea
H3063N.brief: The southern region of Israel, centered around Jerusalem
H3063N.short: Judea, the southern region of Israel, was the center of Jewish life and culture in biblical times, with Jerusalem as its capital.
